summary: Walked through every step of 'Admin - Model Vessel - Route Planning' in the real app as pro user test_session_pro_1 on the Model Vessel at 390x844. The wizard exists: admin-lists returns 36 lines (28 steps + 8 finish lines) and Help > Model Vessel shows 'Route Planning...'. Steps 1-10, 12-15, 17-20, 22-25 and 27 can be done as written, and the buttons and labels match: Add Leg..., Save Leg 2/3/4, Trip plan, Looks good, Prepare to pick up buoy / Prepare to anchor / Prepare to return to Dock, Route Plan card, DEPART, ALL CHECKS DONE, About to depart / Depart now, the UNDERWAY bubble, ARRIVED, ALL ARRIVAL CHECKS DONE, ARRIVE MOORING?, DROP ANCHOR?, New departure..., LEAVE MOORING, WEIGH ANCHOR, My own Ship's Log..., ARRIVED, ALL CHECKS DONE, the Fold step text and Log arrival. The Actual finish was prefilled correctly at each stop: 16/11 11:00, 17/11 07:00 (changed to 08:00), 18/11 09:00, 19/11 11:00. The finish panel is correct (heading 'Route Planning · Well done', 5 ticks, idea line, link) and the link opens Crew Registration and Invites at Step 1 of 14. Mismatches: Step 11 (no Map tab for pro, because route_map is in Admin - disabled features; with it turned on, no pins are placed and no lines or miles are drawn). Steps 15/16/22/24/26 (ARRIVED is blocked until every tank AND battery level is picked on the list first). Steps 21/28 and finish tick 5 (the dolphins entry is NOT folded into the trip, and the result is a 'Trip - Route Plan: ...' log row, not a passage folder). The training window covers the bottom of the Add Leg dialog and of the Prepare to... checklist, so the user has to shrink it.

ui_bugs.component: Trip fold (lib/tripFold.js foldTrip, hooks/useAllDone.js fold condition)
ui_bugs.issue: Ship's Log entries the skipper types during a leg ('My own Ship's Log...', e.g. the dolphins entry) are not attached to the leg's logs[], so foldTrip skips them. After Log arrival, the dolphins entry is still a separate Ship's Log row and the Trip entry's detail does not contain it (checked in the DB: detail has no 'dolphin'). This contradicts Step 21 ('It is kept with this leg, and becomes part of the trip's story when the trip is folded') and Step 28 ('tap it to see each leg, its times, and the dolphins entry'). Fix: attach manual Ship's Log entries to the current leg while underway (push the id into the legs[...].logs of the underway trip), or change the wizard text.
ui_bugs.selector: Ship's Log list after Log arrival

ui_bugs.issue: Each leg's 'departed' time is the moment the button was tapped (local(l.at)), not the Departure entered in New departure. The folded trip reads 'Leg 2: Ship Cove to Tawa Bay, departed 16/11/2026 07:38 (Leave Mooring), arrived 17/11/2026 08:00' (Leg 3 also departed 16/11 07:40, Leg 4 16/11 07:41). For the demo (and any late logging), a departure a day before its leg looks wrong. Consider preferring depart_at when it is set, or accept it and drop the planned times from the wizard.

The training window covers the bottom of the Add Leg dialog: the Mooring / Returning to Dock radios and 'Save Leg N' cannot be clicked (pointer intercepted by WizardWindow; the dialog cannot scroll them above it). The same happens to 'Back to the trip plan' in the Prepare to... checklist peek. The user must shrink the training window, but no step tells them to.

integration_issues.flow: Step 11 View planned route... > Map tab
integration_issues.issue: The Map tab does not appear for the pro user: GET /api/me/features returns disabled ['charter','route_map','speak','sync_stores'], so RouteTabs shows only 'Stops'. With route_map turned on (mocked), the first tap shows the 'Rough outline map' warning ('OK, show the map'). Then no pins exist (stop 1 'Tap the map', stops 2-5 'No pin'), so no legs are drawn and no miles show. In this container the OSM tiles also returned 429. So 'The four legs are drawn over the water... with the miles for each leg. Drag a pin if a place isn't quite right' cannot happen as written.

Tapping ARRIVED, ALL ARRIVAL CHECKS DONE (and ARRIVED, ALL CHECKS DONE on Returning to Dock) before picking the levels opens 'About to log your arrival - Finish this first, then try again: Pick a level for Fuel, LPG, Water, Engine battery, House bank first.' with only OK. The levels must be picked on the list (in the arrival status check) BEFORE tapping ARRIVED, and they include the batteries. Step 16's 'Pick a level for each tank if asked' comes after the tap, and Steps 22/24/26 don't mention levels at all. This was confirmed blocked on Step 15 and Step 26; on 22 and 24 levels were picked before the tap.

issues: The idea line and the 'Crew Registration and Invites...' link are below the visible area of the panel; the user has to scroll inside the panel to see them.
Ship's Log text says 'Fuel Full (about 0 L). Water Full (about 0 L). LPG Full (about 0 kg)' on the Model Vessel: tank capacities are 0, which looks odd in a demo.
The status step says 'Copy the tank and battery status into the Ship's Log: Adequate Fuel, LPG, Water.': the batteries are not named in the summary.
Date/time use native <input type=date/time> pickers (not the shadcn calendar).

wizard_wording_mismatches: Step 11: No Map tab for normal users (route_map is disabled in Admin - disabled features). Even with it on, the real text is 'Tap the map to drop the picked stop's pin. Drag a pin to move a stop...' and the stops show 'Tap the map' / 'No pin'. Suggest: 'Tap View planned route... and choose the Map tab (tap OK, show the map the first time). Tap each stop, then tap the map to drop its pin; the legs are then drawn over the water with the miles for each leg. Tap Done.' Or drop this step if route_map stays off.

Step 15: Add the levels first: 'Open the list menu and choose Arriving at Destination. In its status check pick a level for every tank and battery, then tap ARRIVED, ALL ARRIVAL CHECKS DONE.' The real blocker text is 'Pick a level for Fuel, LPG, Water, Engine battery, House bank first.'

Step 16: 'Pick a level for each tank if asked, then tap ARRIVE MOORING?' The levels can't be picked from this dialog. Remove this, or replace it with 'If it says Finish this first, tap OK, pick the tank and battery levels on the list, and tap ARRIVED again'.
Steps 22, 24, 26: Same as Step 15. Each arrival needs the tank and battery levels picked first; this was confirmed blocked on Returning to Dock without them.

Step 17 / 23 / 25: New departure... opens with START and DESTINATION empty and 'Departure is set to now' (it is not filled in from the planned leg). The wizard says 'Type START Ship Cove' while the plan uses 'Ship Cove, Marlborough Sounds'. Suggest typing the same full name so the trip log reads consistently.
Step 21: 'It is kept with this leg, and becomes part of the trip's story when the trip is folded' is not true today: manual entries are not folded (see the HIGH ui_bug).

Step 28: 'The whole trip is now one passage folder: tap it to see each leg, its times, and the dolphins entry'. The real UI shows one Ship's Log row 'Trip - Route Plan: Route Planning - Mana Marina, Porirua to Mana Marina, Porirua, 16/11/2026 - 19/11/2026 - 4 legs - <time>' with an expand chevron ('Show the full entry') and 'Show the departure reasoning'. It is not a passage folder (those are made by 'Group a passage'), and the dolphins entry stays as its own row above it. Finish tick 5 ('fold the trip into one Ship's Log passage folder') has the same issue.

Steps 6/7/8 and 10: Add a hint to shrink the training window (down arrows), because it covers the arrive type buttons and 'Save Leg N', and the 'Back to the trip plan' button of the Prepare to... checklist.
Step 10: The checklist closes with 'Back to the trip plan' (or X). Consider naming that button.
verified_ok_steps: 1-10 (Leg 1 Arriving at Destination Type on the main Route Planning; Add Leg 2 prefilled START 'Ship Cove, Marlborough Sounds'; Save Leg 2/3/4; Trip plan '4 legs, back at the dock' with LEG 1 · LEAVE DOCK, LEG 2 · LEAVE MOORING, LEG 3 · LEAVE MOORING, LEG 4 · WEIGH ANCHOR and ARRIVE · MOORING/ANCHORING/RETURNING TO DOCK; the Prepare to pick up buoy peek 'Arriving at Destination · 0 of 12 ticked'; Looks good), 12 (Route Plan card Departure 16/11 06:00, Estimated arrival 16/11 11:00), 13-14 ('Leaving the Dock status check', 5 level pickers, 'About to depart' with Tick all 16 items / status / route plan / Underway, Depart now, UNDERWAY bubble on Route Planning), 15-16 (after levels: prefill 16/11 11:00 'Filled in from the Estimated Finish...', ARRIVE MOORING? ticks 12 = general + If mooring), 17-18 (LEAVE MOORING toast 'Leave Mooring: 20 items ticked. Underway on Route Planning, logged in the Ship's Log'), 19-20 (placeholder exactly 'My own Ship's Log...', Add works), 22 (changed to 08:00, note 'This is logged as when you arrived.'), 23-25 (DROP ANCHOR? ticks If anchoring; WEIGH ANCHOR 14 items), 27 (exact fold text, Actual 19/11 11:00, Log arrival), finish panel and link.
action_items: HIGH: Fold manual Ship's Log entries made while underway into the trip (attach them to the current leg's logs), or rewrite Steps 21/28 and finish tick 5.
Fix Step 11: route_map is disabled for users, and no pins are auto-placed. Rewrite it to drop pins by tapping the map, enable route_map, or remove the step.
Rewrite Steps 15/16/22/24/26 so the tank AND battery levels are picked on the list before tapping ARRIVED.
Replace 'passage folder' wording (Step 28, finish tick 5) with the real 'Trip - Route Plan: ...' entry and its 'Show the full entry' expand arrow.
Tell the user to shrink the training window in Steps 6-8 and 10, or make the WizardWindow not cover dialog footers at 390x844.
Optional: say New departure is not prefilled; use 'Ship Cove, Marlborough Sounds' in Step 17; consider using depart_at for the folded 'departed' times.
critical_code_review_comments: useAllDone openArrive: fold shows only when legs.some(l => l.logs?.length), and foldTrip only folds ids in l.logs, so user-typed Ship's Log entries during a trip are never folded.
tripFold legLine prefers local(l.at) (tap time) over depart_at, which gives departures earlier than the previous arrival when the skipper logs later than planned.
RouteTabs hides the Map tab behind useFeature('route_map'), which is in the DEFAULT disabled list and in the admin's disabled list, so wizard Step 11 is unreachable for normal users.

success_rate.frontend: about 75% of the wizard steps can be done exactly as written (21 of 28); finish panel 100%

seed_data_creation: None. I backed up the pro user's Model Vessel copy (user_boats owner test-user-pro, boat_id model_vessel) to /tmp/mv_backup.json, ran the full trip, then restored it with replaceOne (Ship's Log back to 1 item, route fields empty). I deleted only test-user-pro's db.wizard_progress docs (3). Another user's docs (user_aa9bab39fc2c, 2) were left alone because they may be real data. The master Model Vessel was not touched.
